{{- /* JSON-LD structured data: breadcrumbs for every page below the home page, and a TechArticle for regular content pages. */ -}} {{- $page := .page -}} {{- $publisher := dict "@type" "Organization" "name" "The Things Industries" "url" "https://www.thethingsindustries.com" "logo" ("apple-touch-icon.png" | absURL) -}} {{- if not $page.IsHome }} {{- $items := slice -}} {{- $pos := 0 -}} {{- range $page.Ancestors.Reverse }} {{- $pos = add $pos 1 -}} {{- $name := cond .IsHome "Docs" .Title -}} {{- $items = $items | append (dict "@type" "ListItem" "position" $pos "name" $name "item" .Permalink) -}} {{- end }} {{- $items = $items | append (dict "@type" "ListItem" "position" (add $pos 1) "name" $page.Title "item" $page.Permalink) -}} {{- $breadcrumbs := dict "@context" "https://schema.org" "@type" "BreadcrumbList" "itemListElement" $items }} {{- end }} {{- if $page.IsPage }} {{- $article := dict "@context" "https://schema.org" "@type" "TechArticle" "headline" $page.Title "description" .description "url" $page.Permalink "inLanguage" $page.Site.LanguageCode "image" ("docs-thumbnail.png" | absURL) "publisher" $publisher "isPartOf" (dict "@type" "WebSite" "name" $page.Site.Title "url" ("" | absURL)) -}} {{- if not $page.Lastmod.IsZero }} {{- $article = merge $article (dict "dateModified" ($page.Lastmod.Format "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00")) -}} {{- end }} {{- else if $page.IsHome }} {{- $site := dict "@context" "https://schema.org" "@type" "WebSite" "name" (printf "%s Documentation" $page.Site.Title) "url" $page.Permalink "inLanguage" $page.Site.LanguageCode "publisher" $publisher -}} {{- end }}
